newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's March industrial output rises 9.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's March industrial output rises 9.1 pct.

text.p: South Korea's industrial output in March rose 9.1 percent year-on-year, up from a 5.8 percent rise a year earlier, provisional National Statistical Office (NSO) figures showed on Tuesday.
Note: figures in percent, year-on-year change.
The NSO figures showed industrial output rose 1.5 percent in March from February against a 0.9 percent fall a year ago and a rise of 2.8 percent in February.

Output in March inproved from a year ago as semiconductor makers began producing the 64 megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips and refiners raised production of oil products on recovering export prices.

The office said output of semiconductors in March rose 45.4 percent on the year, while oil products, and office and accounting equipment such as personal computers increased 27.2 percent and 31.3 percent, respectively.
Output of heavy industrial goods in the month rose year-on-year 13.0 percent against an 8.4 percent rise a year ago, while that of light industrial goods fell 5.7 percent, against a 4.6 percent fall.
Industrial output in the first quarter of this year rose year-on-year 7.1 percent, down from 8.6 percent a year before, the office said.
The office figures showed ex-factory shipments for exports in March increased year-on-year 10.3 percent, against an 18.4 percent rise a year before.
Shipments to the domestic market rose 3.9 percent, compared with a rise of 4.3 percent a year ago.
